details.description: Gemini Omni Flash (gemini-omni-1.1-flash) is Google DeepMind's fast, natively multimodal model for video generation and conversational video editing, part of the Gemini 3 model line. It turns text prompts and reference images into short videos with synchronized, prompt-driven native audio, and lets users iteratively edit or extend clips, such as element replacement, perspective changes, and keyframe interpolation, across multiple turns via Google's Interactions API. Google's Gemini API docs list it as a stable, generally available model and recommend it as the default choice for video generation; per Google's changelog, it is the GA release that succeeds the gemini-omni-flash-preview endpoint, which Google is deprecating on September 30, 2026.
advantages: Google recommends it as the default model for video generation on the Gemini API, citing superior video coherence, multi-input reasoning, character consistency, and factual accuracy across edits, per Google's documentation.
Accepts text, image, audio, and video input simultaneously and generates videos with a synthesized, prompt-driven native audio track, per Google's documentation.
Supports multi-turn conversational editing of generated videos, including element replacement and perspective changes, via the Interactions API, per Google's documentation.
Offers output resolutions from 360p up to 4K (upscaled) in both landscape (16:9) and portrait (9:16) aspect ratios, per Google's documentation.
disadvantages: Full language support is limited to English; other languages have not been evaluated, per Google's documentation.
Does not support custom system instructions or temperature/top_p adjustments, per Google's documentation.
Certain editing capabilities are restricted for users in the EEA, Switzerland, and the UK, per Google's documentation.
Input videos for editing or extension are limited to 10 seconds per turn, per Google's documentation.
use_cases: Generating short videos from text prompts and reference images
Iteratively editing existing video clips through natural-language conversation
Extending video clips and interpolating between first/last keyframes
Producing videos with synchronized, prompt-driven audio

notes: Catalog classifies this target as Bud's 'chat' kind (routed to /v1/chat/completions) with modality audio_input/image_input/text_input/text_output, but Google's own docs describe gemini-omni-1.1-flash as a video generation and conversational video editing model whose output is short video with native audio, not a text-chat model; Bud's modality taxonomy has no video category so this isn't visible in the facts. Kept the catalog's facts as given per instructions. No maker-published 0-100 accuracy benchmark was found for this model, so evaluations is left empty; no context-window or output-token figures were stated on the pages checked, so no conflict with the catalog's numeric facts either. The original draft said this model built on and superseded a 'gemini-omni-1.0-flash' version, but no page names such a model; Google's changelog shows gemini-omni-1.1-flash is instead the GA successor to the gemini-omni-flash-preview endpoint, so the description was corrected to match.
